notes: Monthly recap: on the first open of a new month you'll see last month at a glance: what you paid toward debt, how much less you owe, debts paid off, badges, and whether your debt-free date moved. It's also on the Wins tab, with a card to share.
Year in review: from mid-December, your year's payments, debts paid off and progress in one place, with a share card.
Faster start: after adding your first debts, slide to set how much goes to debt each month and watch your debt-free date move, add due dates, and turn on reminders in one step.

Balance transfer fees now stay exactly as entered. Before, the fee % shown could drift after editing a balance, changing the fee % charged it twice, turning the promo off and on added a second fee, and the fee box could carry over from the last debt you opened. Older transfers keep the dollars you were charged; if the rate shown looks off, type the right one once and it sticks.
